context: Aoi and Mei develop a new cafe drink.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (甘い/カップ/素材/快適/過ぎる) in natural home.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 新しい甘いドリンク、考えたの!
lines.en: I came up with a new sweet drink!
lines.style: excited barista voice, soft warm bubbly delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いいね、どんな素材を使うの?
lines.en: Nice, what ingredients do you use?
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 自然な素材で、優しい甘さなの。
lines.en: Natural ingredients, with a gentle sweetness.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: この大きいカップ、いいね。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: カップも、手に快適なものを選んだの。
lines.en: I chose a cup that's comfortable in the hand.
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 甘過ぎると、飽きちゃうかな?
lines.en: If it's too sweet, will people tire of it?
lines.style: thoughtful woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 甘過ぎないよう、素材を調整したよ。
lines.en: I adjusted the ingredients so it's not too sweet.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 快適なカップで、ゆっくり飲めるね。
lines.en: With a comfortable cup, you can sip slowly.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
